description_en: Creates a task to download local recordings by time
description_zh: 调用该接口创建按时间下载本地录像的任务
name: CreateLocalRecordDownloadByTimeJob

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview tab of the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

You can view information about all products under the current instance on the Products page of the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台的产品页面或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html接口，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the video device. You can view the DeviceName of devices under a specified product on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation.


<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页面，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查看指定产品下设备的**DeviceName**。


<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The upload speed multiplier of the device. Default value: 1.0. Valid values: 0.125 to 8.0
parameters.help_zh: 设备上传倍速。 默认值1.0，取值范围为0.125~8.0
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en: The start time. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 2147483647
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为10位的时间戳，单位为秒。取值范围0~2147483647
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the video device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation to query the device ID.

<notice>
IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html接口查询。

<notice>
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 2147483647. The value must be greater than the value of BeginTime
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，格式为10位的时间戳，单位为秒。取值范围为0~2147483647，必须大于开始时间BeginTime
parameters.name: end_time
